exposure: uterine artery embolization (UAE) combined with dilatation and curettage
methotrexate combined with dilatation and curettage
cohort: 52 patients diagnosed with cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) at the First Affiliated Hospital of Xi'an Jiaotong University, China, between March 2009 and March 2014
finding: Incorporating uterine artery embolization in the treatment of CSP-I and CSP-II was safe, and treatment should be selected based on CSP type.
